sgs.skill.rende.description: Give hand cards to other players. After giving a total of two cards in a turn, recover 1 HP.
sgs.skill.jijiang.description: Lord skill: ask another Shu player to provide Slash. When used during your play phase, choose the attack target.
sgs.skill.paoxiao.description: Locked: there is no limit to the number of Slashes you may use.
sgs.skill.longdan.description: Use or play Slash as Dodge, or Dodge as Slash.
sgs.skill.jianxiong.description: After surviving damage, you may take the physical cards that caused it if they remain in the processing area.
sgs.skill.hujia.description: Lord skill: when you need Dodge, ask another Wei player to provide one.
sgs.skill.kurou.description: Lose 1 HP. If you survive the dying resolution, draw two cards.
sgs.skill.wusheng.description: Use or play a red hand card or equipped card as a normal Slash.
sgs.skill.jizhi.description: When you use a non-delayed trick, you may draw one card. Recasting is not using a card.
sgs.skill.qicai.description: Locked: your trick cards have no distance limit.
sgs.skill.zhiheng.description: Once per play phase, discard any number of hand or equipped cards and draw the same number.
sgs.skill.jiuyuan.description: Lord skill: when another Wu player uses Peach on you while you are dying, recover 1 extra HP. Your own Peach does not gain this bonus.
sgs.skill.keji.description: If you neither used nor played Slash during this turn's play phase, you may skip the discard phase.
sgs.skill.qixi.description: During your play phase, use a black hand or equipped card as Dismantlement.
sgs.skill.jijiu.description: Outside your turn, use a red hand or equipped card as Peach. You may rescue yourself.
sgs.skill.qingnang.description: Once per play phase, discard one hand card to let any wounded player recover 1 HP.
sgs.skill.yingzi.description: During your draw phase, you may draw one extra card.
sgs.skill.fanjian.description: Once per play phase, another player guesses a suit, then a random card from your hand is revealed. If wrong, they take 1 damage from you. They obtain the card only if they survive the damage and dying resolution.
sgs.skill.qianxun.description: Locked: you cannot be targeted by Snatch or Indulgence.
sgs.skill.lianying.description: After losing your last hand card, you may draw one card.
sgs.skill.fankui.description: After surviving damage, you may take a random hidden hand card or a chosen equipped card from its source. Judgment cards cannot be taken.
sgs.skill.guicai.description: After a judgment card is revealed but before it takes effect, you may replace it with one hand card. Once per judgment.
sgs.skill.tiandu.description: After your judgment takes effect, you may obtain the final judgment card. This does not change the resolved result.
sgs.skill.yiji.description: After surviving each point of damage, look at the top two cards and give them one at a time to any living players, including yourself.
sgs.skill.luoyi.description: During your draw phase, you may draw one fewer card. Damage you deal with Slash or Duel this turn increases by 1.
sgs.skill.jieyin.description: Once per play phase, discard two hand cards and choose another wounded male player. You both recover 1 HP.
sgs.skill.xiaoji.description: After losing cards from your equipment area in one event, you may draw two cards. Losing several at once triggers this only once.
sgs.skill.tuxi.description: Instead of drawing in your draw phase, choose up to two different other players and take a random hand card from each.
sgs.skill.guanxing.description: During preparation, view up to five top cards, capped by the number of living players. Place them on the top or bottom in your chosen order. Unselected cards return to the top in their original order.
sgs.skill.kongcheng.description: Locked: with no hand cards, you cannot be targeted by Slash or Duel. Losing your last card after targets are chosen does not cancel the card.
sgs.skill.qingguo.description: Use or play a black hand card as Dodge. Equipped cards cannot be used.
sgs.skill.luoshen.description: During preparation, you may repeatedly judge. Obtain each final black judgment card. Stop on red or when you choose to stop.
sgs.skill.ganglie.description: After surviving damage, you may judge. Unless the result is a heart, the source must discard two hand cards or take 1 damage from you.
sgs.skill.lijian.description: Once per play phase, discard one hand or equipped card and choose two other male players. The first uses an uncounterable Duel on the second; the second plays Slash first.
sgs.skill.biyue.description: During your finish phase, after the discard phase, you may draw one card.
sgs.skill.mashu.description: Locked: your distance to other players is reduced by 1, to a minimum of 1.
sgs.skill.tieji.description: After choosing a Slash target, you may judge. On red, the Slash cannot be dodged. Passive armor effects still apply.
sgs.skill.guose.description: During your play phase, use a diamond hand or equipped card as Indulgence.
sgs.skill.liuli.description: When targeted by Slash, you may discard one hand or equipped card to redirect it to another player in your attack range after paying the cost. You cannot redirect it to the attacker.
sgs.skill.wushuang.description: Locked: your Slash requires two consecutive Dodges. An opponent in a Duel with you must play two consecutive Slashes each round.
sgs.skill.liegong.description: After choosing a Slash target in your play phase, if their hand size is at least your HP or at most your attack range, you may prevent them from responding with Dodge.
sgs.skill.kuanggu.description: Locked: after each point of damage you deal to a player within distance 1, recover 1 HP. Distance is checked before the damage.
sgs.skill.duanliang.description: During your play phase, use a black basic or equipment card as Supply Shortage. Your distance limit for Supply Shortage is 2.
sgs.skill.qiangxi.description: Once per play phase, lose 1 HP or discard a weapon to deal 1 damage to another player in your attack range. If you discard an equipped weapon, range is checked afterward.
sgs.skill.yizhong.description: Locked: while you have no armor equipped, black Slashes have no effect on you. Sword of Steel cannot ignore this hero skill.
sgs.skill.yaowu.description: Locked: when you take damage from a red Slash, its source chooses to recover 1 HP or draw one card. At full HP they draw.
sgs.skill.yicong.description: Locked: above 2 HP, your distance to others is reduced by 1. At 2 HP or less, others' distance to you increases by 1.
sgs.skill.huangtian_give.description: Once per play phase, give a Dodge or Lightning to Zhang Jiao as Lord.
sgs.skill.zhiba_pindian.description: Once per play phase, challenge Sun Ce as Lord to Pindian. If you do not win, he may take both Pindian cards.
sgs.skill.shensu.description: Skip judgment and draw, or discard an equipment card and skip play, to use a Slash without a distance limit.
sgs.skill.jushou.description: During your finish phase, you may draw three cards, then turn over.
sgs.skill.tianxiang.description: When taking damage, discard a heart hand card to transfer it to another player. If they survive, they draw cards equal to their lost HP.
sgs.skill.hongyan.description: Locked: your spade cards are treated as hearts.
sgs.skill.buqu.description: When HP drops below 1, you may reveal enough cards to cover the HP deficit and place them on your hero. If all ranks differ, you do not die. Remove excess cards after recovering HP.
sgs.skill.leiji.description: After using or playing Dodge, you may make a player judge. On a spade, deal 2 thunder damage to them.
sgs.skill.guidao.description: Before a judgment takes effect, replace it with a black hand or equipped card and obtain the original judgment card.
sgs.skill.huangtian.description: Lord skill: once during each other Independent player's play phase, they may give you a Dodge or Lightning.
sgs.skill.guhuo.description: Declare a hand card as a basic or non-delayed trick. Others may question it. If true, questioners lose HP; if false, they draw. When questioned, only a true heart card takes effect.
sgs.skill.quhu.description: Once per play phase, challenge a player with more HP to Pindian. If you win, they deal 1 damage to a target you choose within their range. Otherwise, they deal 1 damage to you.
sgs.skill.jieming.description: After each point of damage you take, you may let a player draw up to their maximum HP in hand cards, capped at five.
sgs.skill.bazhen.description: While you have no armor equipped, you are treated as having Eight Trigrams.
sgs.skill.huoji.description: Use a red hand card as Fire Attack.
sgs.skill.kanpo.description: Use a black hand card as Counterspell.
sgs.skill.lianhuan.description: Use or recast a club hand card as Iron Chain.
sgs.skill.niepan.description: Limited: while dying, discard all your cards, reset your hero card, draw three cards, and recover to 3 HP, capped by your maximum.
sgs.skill.tianyi.description: Once per play phase, challenge another player to Pindian. If you win, this turn your Slash limit and target limit each increase by 1 and Slash has no distance limit. Otherwise, you cannot use Slash.
sgs.skill.luanji.description: Use two hand cards of the same suit as Archery Attack.
sgs.skill.xueyi.description: Lord skill: your hand limit increases by twice the number of other living Independent players.
sgs.skill.shuangxiong.description: Instead of drawing in your draw phase, judge and obtain the judgment card. This turn you may use hand cards of the opposite color as Duel.
sgs.skill.mengjin.description: After your Slash is dodged, you may discard one of the target's hand or equipped cards.
sgs.skill.xingshang.description: When another player dies, you may obtain all their hand and equipped cards.
sgs.skill.fangzhu.description: After taking damage, you may let another player draw cards equal to your lost HP, then turn over.
sgs.skill.songwei.description: Lord skill: after another Wei player's black judgment takes effect, they may let you draw one card.
sgs.skill.huoshou.description: Barbarian Invasion has no effect on you. When another player uses it, you become its damage source.
sgs.skill.zaiqi.description: Instead of drawing, reveal cards equal to your lost HP. Recover 1 HP for each heart and obtain the remaining cards.
sgs.skill.juxiang.description: Barbarian Invasion has no effect on you. After another player's Barbarian Invasion resolves, obtain its physical cards.
sgs.skill.lieren.description: After dealing damage with Slash, you may challenge the damaged player to Pindian. If you win, obtain one of their hand or equipped cards.
sgs.skill.yinghun.description: During preparation, if wounded, choose another player to draw X and discard 1, or draw 1 and discard X, where X is your lost HP.
sgs.skill.haoshi.description: During your draw phase, you may draw two extra cards. If you then have more than five hand cards, give half, rounded down, to another player with the fewest hand cards.
sgs.skill.dimeng.description: Once per play phase, choose two other players, discard cards equal to their hand size difference, then swap their entire hands.
sgs.skill.jiuchi.description: Use a spade hand card as Wine.
sgs.skill.roulin.description: Locked: Slashes you use against female heroes, and Slashes female heroes use against you, require two consecutive Dodges.
sgs.skill.benghuai.description: During your finish phase, if your HP is not the lowest, lose 1 HP or 1 maximum HP.
sgs.skill.baonue.description: Lord skill: after another Independent player deals damage, they may judge. On a spade, you recover 1 HP.
sgs.skill.wansha.description: Locked: during your turn, only you and the dying player may use Peach.
sgs.skill.luanwu.description: Limited: each other player, in order, must use Slash on a nearest player or lose 1 HP.
sgs.skill.weimu.description: Locked: you cannot be targeted by black trick cards.
sgs.skill.tuntian.description: After losing hand or equipped cards outside your turn, you may judge. A non-heart judgment becomes a Field. Reduce your distance to others by the number of Fields.
sgs.skill.zaoxian.description: Awakening: during preparation, with at least three Fields, lose 1 maximum HP and gain Jixi.
sgs.skill.jixi.description: Use a Field as Snatch. Choose the Field to consume after activating.
sgs.skill.qiaobian.description: Before judgment, draw, play, or discard, discard a hand card to skip that phase. Skipping draw lets you take hand cards from up to two players; skipping play lets you move one card on the table.
sgs.skill.tiaoxin.description: Once per play phase, choose another player whose attack range includes you. They must use Slash on you, or you discard one of their cards.
sgs.skill.zhiji.description: Awakening: during preparation, with no hand cards, recover 1 HP or draw two cards, then lose 1 maximum HP and gain Stargazing.
sgs.skill.xiangle.description: Locked: after you become a Slash target, its user must discard a basic card or the Slash has no effect on you.
sgs.skill.fangquan.description: You may skip your play phase. At turn end, discard a hand card to let another player take an extra turn.
sgs.skill.ruoyu.description: Lord awakening: during preparation, if your HP is the lowest, gain 1 maximum HP, recover 1 HP, and gain Rally.
sgs.skill.jiang.description: After using or becoming a target of a red Slash or Duel, you may draw one card.
sgs.skill.hunzi.description: Awakening: during preparation, at 1 HP, lose 1 maximum HP and gain Heroism and Heroic Soul.
sgs.skill.zhiba.description: Lord skill: once during each other Wu player's play phase, they may challenge you to Pindian. If they do not win, you may take both cards. After Awakened Soul, you may refuse the challenge.
sgs.skill.zhijian.description: Place an equipment card from your hand into another player's empty equipment slot, then draw one card.
sgs.skill.guzheng.description: At the end of another player's discard phase, you may return one hand card they discarded that phase, then obtain the other discarded cards still in the discard pile.
sgs.skill.beige.description: After a player takes Slash damage, discard a card to make them judge: heart recovers 1 HP; diamond draws two; club makes the source discard two; spade turns the source over.
sgs.skill.duanchang.description: Locked: when you die, your killer loses their hero skills.
sgs.skill.huashen.description: At game start, randomly obtain two unused hero cards. During preparation or finish, choose a form and one of its non-Lord, non-limited, non-awakening skills. Gain its kingdom and gender.
sgs.skill.xinsheng.description: After each point of damage you take, you may randomly obtain a new form.
